fields.name: date_of_birth
fields.description: Member date of birth from eligibility data or a dated clinical record.

fields.name: age_years
fields.description: Completed years on the request date (7.5).

fields.name: bmi_recorded
fields.description: BMI as written in a dated note, with its date. Used as written, never rounded (7.6).

fields.name: height
fields.description: Height with unit and measurement date.

fields.name: weight
fields.description: Weight with unit and measurement date.

fields.name: bmi
fields.description: Recorded BMI if present on a date; otherwise calculated from same-date height and weight after unit conversion, rounded to one decimal, 0.05 rounds up (7.6).

fields.name: sleep_study_date
fields.description: Date of each diagnostic sleep study.

fields.name: sleep_study_type
fields.description: Study type. A titration study is not a diagnostic sleep study (7.7).

fields.name: ahi
fields.description: AHI from the diagnostic study (REI for a home test). Pick the 4% value when several rules are reported (7.8).

fields.name: ahi_scoring_rule
fields.description: Hypopnea rule for the AHI value extracted.

fields.name: central_apneas
fields.description: Central apneas from the same study.

fields.name: mixed_apneas
fields.description: Mixed apneas from the same study, in the same unit as central_apneas.

fields.name: total_apneas_hypopneas
fields.description: All apneas plus hypopneas from the same study, in the same unit.

fields.name: central_mixed_share_pct
fields.description: (central + mixed) / total x 100 (7.9). A percentage stated in the report is used only when the counts are absent.

fields.name: dise_date
fields.description: Date of each DISE.

fields.name: sleep_visit_date
fields.description: Date of each visit with a sleep medicine clinician.

fields.name: sleep_visit_mode
fields.description: How the visit took place.

fields.name: titration_residual_ahi
fields.description: AHI at the best tolerated or final recommended pressure on an attended titration study.

fields.name: pap_device_residual_ahi
fields.description: Device-estimated AHI for the period covered by a usage report.

fields.name: pap_pct_nights_4h
fields.description: Percent of nights with at least 4 hours of use in a usage report, with the report's start and end dates.

fields.name: pap_report_days
fields.description: Length of the usage-report period, from its start and end dates.

fields.name: tonsil_grade
fields.description: Tonsil size grade from the most recent airway exam, with its date.

fields.name: mi_date
fields.description: Date of any documented myocardial infarction.

criteria.policy_text: The member's age is at least 22 years on the request date.
criteria.summary: Member is at least 22 on the request date

criteria.policy_text: The member's body mass index (BMI) is less than 35.0 kg/m², using the most recent value documented within 6 months before the request date.
criteria.summary: Most recent BMI in the last 6 months is less than 35.0

flag_rules.when: Two BMI values share the latest date and disagree, or an earlier BMI in the window falls on the other side of 35.0 (7.4)

criteria.policy_text: All of the following, using the most recent value from a diagnostic sleep study:
criteria.summary: Most recent diagnostic sleep study is recent and shows qualifying obstructive severity

flag_rules.when: An earlier diagnostic study inside the 24-month window would change whether 3.3(b), (c) or (d) is met (7.4)
The study's AHI is given only for a 3% or arousal-based hypopnea rule (7.8)

children.policy_text: The study was performed within 24 months before the request date.
children.summary: Sleep study within 24 months

children.policy_text: The apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) is at least 15 events per hour.
children.summary: AHI at least 15

children.policy_text: The AHI is no more than 65 events per hour.
children.summary: AHI no more than 65

children.policy_text: The central and mixed apnea share is less than 25%.
children.summary: Central plus mixed apneas less than 25% of events

criteria.summary: Recent DISE without complete concentric collapse at the soft palate

children.policy_text: A drug-induced sleep endoscopy (DISE) was performed within 24 months before the request date.
children.summary: DISE within 24 months

children.policy_text: The DISE report states that complete concentric collapse at the level of the soft palate was not seen.
children.summary: DISE report states no complete concentric collapse at the soft palate
children.evidence: A sentence in the most recent DISE report that describes the soft-palate collapse pattern and shows it was not complete concentric collapse. Silence about the soft palate is insufficient evidence. Wording such as 'near-complete' or 'predominantly concentric' is not clearly met.

flag_rules.when: The report describes soft-palate collapse with a hedge such as near-complete, predominantly or mostly concentric

criteria.summary: Sleep specialist saw the member in the last 12 months and recommends HGNS

children.policy_text: The member had a face-to-face or video visit with a sleep medicine clinician within 12 months before the request date.
children.summary: In-person or video sleep visit within 12 months
children.evidence: A dated note by a sleep medicine clinician from an in-person or video visit. A telephone-only visit does not count.

children.policy_text: The note from that visit recommends hypoglossal nerve stimulation for this member.
children.summary: That visit's note recommends HGNS
children.evidence: A sentence in the note of a visit that meets 3.5(a) recommending hypoglossal nerve stimulation, or calling the member a good candidate for it. A referral only to discuss the option is insufficient evidence.

criteria.summary: PAP was tried first and failed or was not tolerated

children.policy_text: PAP failure, as defined in 7.14
children.summary: PAP failure: AHI still at least 15 on PAP

flag_rules.when: A clinician describes PAP failure on symptoms alone (for example persistent sleepiness) with no qualifying residual AHI

children.policy_text: The member used PAP therapy.
children.summary: Member used PAP
children.evidence: A dated record showing the member used CPAP, APAP or BPAP.

children.policy_text: While on PAP therapy, the AHI was at least 15 events per hour, shown by either an attended titration study at the best pressure the member tolerated, or a device usage report covering a 30-day period of adequate PAP use.
children.summary: Residual AHI at least 15 on titration study or on 30 days of adequate device use

children.policy_text: an attended titration study at the best pressure the member tolerated
children.summary: Titration study residual AHI at least 15

children.policy_text: a device usage report covering a 30-day period of adequate PAP use
children.summary: Device report: adequate use over at least 30 days with residual AHI at least 15

children.policy_text: Device-recorded use of at least 4 hours per night on at least 70% of nights during a period of 30 consecutive days.
children.summary: At least 70% of nights with 4+ hours

children.policy_text: during a period of 30 consecutive days
children.summary: Usage report covers at least 30 consecutive days

children.policy_text: the AHI was at least 15 events per hour
children.summary: Device residual AHI at least 15 for that period

children.policy_text: PAP intolerance, as defined in 7.15
children.summary: PAP intolerance: stopped or unable, with a reason, a fix attempt and low use

children.policy_text: The member started PAP therapy.
children.summary: Member started PAP
children.evidence: A dated record showing the member started CPAP, APAP or BPAP.

children.policy_text: A clinician documents that the member is unable to continue PAP therapy, or stopped using it.
children.summary: Clinician documents member cannot continue or stopped PAP
children.evidence: A clinician's statement that the member cannot continue PAP or has stopped using it.

children.policy_text: The record names at least one specific reason, such as mask discomfort, claustrophobia, pressure intolerance, swallowing air, skin breakdown or sleep disrupted by the device.
children.summary: A specific reason is named
children.evidence: A specific reason the member could not use PAP. 'Did not tolerate' with no reason is insufficient evidence.

children.policy_text: The record shows at least one attempt to fix the problem before the member stopped, such as a mask change or refit, a pressure change, added humidification or a desensitization program.
children.summary: At least one fix was tried before stopping
children.evidence: A record of at least one troubleshooting step (mask change or refit, pressure change, humidification, desensitization) dated before the member stopped PAP.

children.policy_text: A device usage report or a clinician note shows the member did not achieve adequate PAP use.
children.summary: Use stayed below the adequate-use benchmark

children.policy_text: A device usage report or a clinician note shows the member did not achieve adequate PAP use.
children.summary: Device report: less than 70% of nights with 4+ hours in the last 30 days of use

children.policy_text: A device usage report or a clinician note shows the member did not achieve adequate PAP use.
children.summary: Clinician note states use below the benchmark
children.evidence: A clinician note giving hours or nights of use that fall below at least 4 hours on at least 70% of nights, or stating the member stopped PAP within 30 days of starting.

contraindications.policy_text: A neuromuscular disease that affects control of the tongue or upper airway, such as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis or myasthenia gravis.
contraindications.summary: Neuromuscular disease affecting tongue or airway
contraindications.evidence: Any mention, current or historical, in problem list, history or notes.

contraindications.policy_text: Weakness or paralysis of either hypoglossal nerve, from any cause.
contraindications.evidence: Any mention, including tongue deviation or atrophy attributed to the nerve. A history described as resolved still counts as found.

contraindications.policy_text: Tonsil size of at least grade 3 on a 0 to 4 scale, on the most recent documented airway exam.
Another upper airway finding, such as a tongue-base mass or severe nasal obstruction, that a treating surgeon has documented needs correction before implant.
contraindications.summary: Airway finding a surgeon says must be fixed first
contraindications.evidence: A surgeon's statement that an airway finding needs correction before implant.

contraindications.policy_text: Chronic lung disease that requires supplemental oxygen while awake.
contraindications.evidence: Home or daytime supplemental oxygen for a chronic lung disease, in history, medication or equipment lists.

contraindications.policy_text: Pulmonary hypertension documented as moderate or severe.
contraindications.evidence: Pulmonary hypertension described as moderate or severe.

contraindications.policy_text: Heart failure documented as New York Heart Association class III or class IV.
contraindications.summary: Heart failure NYHA III or IV
contraindications.evidence: Heart failure with NYHA class III or IV stated.

contraindications.policy_text: A heart attack (myocardial infarction) within 6 months before the request date.
contraindications.summary: Heart attack in the last 6 months

contraindications.policy_text: Heart valve disease documented as severe.

contraindications.evidence: Pregnancy documented as current in the most recent record that addresses pregnancy status.

contraindications.policy_text: An expected, ongoing need for MRI scans that the planned device's labeling does not permit.
contraindications.summary: Ongoing MRI need the device cannot accept
contraindications.evidence: A documented expected need for repeated MRI. Any such mention is treated as found, because the engine cannot check device labeling.

contraindications.policy_text: Another active implanted electrical device, such as a pacemaker, defibrillator or spinal cord stimulator, unless a treating clinician documents that interaction between the devices has been evaluated and is acceptable.
contraindications.summary: Another active implanted device, without a clearance statement
contraindications.evidence: Any active implanted electrical device in history, device or medication lists, or imaging.

exception.policy_text: unless a treating clinician documents that interaction between the devices has been evaluated and is acceptable
exception.summary: Clinician states device interaction was evaluated and is acceptable
exception.evidence: A specific clinician statement that interaction between the devices was evaluated and is acceptable. A bare mention of the device does not count.

contraindications.policy_text: A cognitive, psychiatric or physical condition documented as preventing the member from operating the device's handheld remote, with no caregiver documented as able to do so.
contraindications.summary: Cannot operate the remote and no caregiver can
contraindications.evidence: A statement that a condition prevents the member from using the remote, and no statement that a caregiver can.

contraindications.policy_text: Untreated narcolepsy or another untreated central disorder of excessive sleepiness.
contraindications.evidence: Narcolepsy or idiopathic hypersomnia with no documented treatment.

exclusions.policy_text: The member already has a hypoglossal nerve stimulator implanted.
exclusions.evidence: An existing hypoglossal nerve stimulator in history, device list or imaging.

exclusions.policy_text: The request is for snoring alone, without obstructive sleep apnea that meets 3.3.
exclusions.evidence: The request or notes state the goal is snoring, and 3.3 is not met.

exclusions.policy_text: The planned device does not have US Food and Drug Administration marketing authorization for treating obstructive sleep apnea.
exclusions.summary: Device lacks FDA authorization for OSA
exclusions.evidence: A statement that the planned device is investigational or not FDA-authorized for OSA. The engine cannot confirm authorization; it only finds statements.

documentation.name: Member date of birth
documentation.must_show: Date of birth, from Northwind eligibility data or a dated clinical record

documentation.name: Office visit note with vital signs
documentation.must_show: Visit date; height and weight, or a recorded BMI

documentation.name: Diagnostic sleep study report
documentation.must_show: Study date; study type; AHI (or REI for a home test); hypopnea scoring rule; counts or percentages of central and mixed apneas; interpreting physician's signature

documentation.name: DISE report
documentation.must_show: Procedure date; level-by-level description of airway collapse, including the pattern at the soft palate; performing clinician

documentation.name: Sleep medicine consultation note
documentation.must_show: Visit date; visit type (in person or video); clinician's credentials; recommendation for hypoglossal nerve stimulation; status of other sleep disorders

documentation.name: PAP records
documentation.must_show: Device usage report (dates covered, nightly hours, percent of nights with at least 4 hours, residual AHI) or titration study report; clinic notes on PAP problems, the reason use stopped and each step taken to fix it

documentation.name: Surgical consultation or history and physical
documentation.must_show: Visit date; airway exam with tonsil grade; problem list; medication list; implanted devices; cardiac, lung, neurologic and pregnancy status; ability to use the remote

ambiguities.issue: Must 3.3(b), (c) and (d) all come from the same study as 3.3(a)?
readings: All four from the single most recent diagnostic study
Each sub-item may be met by any study in the window
ambiguities.recommended: Same study. Mixing studies could pass a member no single study qualifies.
ambiguities.encoded_as: 021-C3 has select=most_recent at the group level; children read that one study.

ambiguities.issue: Same-date BMI values from two sources that differ only by rounding (34.96 in vitals, 35.0 in the note)
ambiguities.recommended: Conflict. 7.4 says same-date disagreement is a conflict, and this sits on the cutoff.

ambiguities.issue: BMI recorded on one date, height and weight on a later date in the window
readings: Most recent date wins, whether recorded or calculated
ambiguities.recommended: Most recent date wins. 7.6 governs how a value is formed; 7.4 governs which date is used.
ambiguities.encoded_as: Field bmi is derived per date, then select=most_recent applies.

ambiguities.issue: Several DISE reports in the window
readings: Any DISE without complete concentric collapse
ambiguities.encoded_as: 021-C4a has select=most_recent; 021-C4b reads the same report.

readings: Any mention, including a referral to discuss
ambiguities.recommended: Explicit recommendation or 'good candidate'; a referral only to discuss is insufficient (from Appendix A.2).

ambiguities.issue: A visit with no stated mode (in person, video or phone)
ambiguities.recommended: Count it when the note records an exam or vital signs taken that day; otherwise insufficient.
ambiguities.encoded_as: Not yet encoded. Needs your call before the extractor prompt is written.

ambiguities.issue: Titration report does not say which pressure was best tolerated
readings: Use the AHI at the final or recommended pressure
ambiguities.recommended: Use the AHI at the final or recommended pressure.

ambiguities.issue: Device report longer than 30 days, for example 90 days at 72% of nights
readings: Whole-report percentage stands in for the best 30-day period
ambiguities.recommended: Whole-report percentage counts when the report covers at least 30 days. It is a conservative stand-in, since some 30-day stretch must be at least as good.
ambiguities.encoded_as: 021-C6a.2-ii.1 and .2 test the report as a whole.

ambiguities.issue: Which period counts for 'did not achieve adequate use' when the member used PAP well for years and then stopped
readings: Never achieved adequate use in any 30-day period
Did not achieve it in the last 30 days of use before stopping
ambiguities.recommended: Last 30 days of use before stopping. The first reading excludes members whose tolerance changed over time, which is a common real story.
ambiguities.encoded_as: 021-C6b.5-i summary; extractor must return the report closest to the stop date.

ambiguities.recommended: Only residual AHI counts for approve-ready; symptom-only failure goes to clinician review (from Appendix A.2).

ambiguities.issue: Contraindication documented as history or resolved
ambiguities.recommended: Treat as found. It only sends the case to a person, which is the safe direction.

ambiguities.issue: Pregnancy status not addressed anywhere in the chart
ambiguities.recommended: Not found. Contraindications are triggered by documentation; requiring proof of absence would send nearly every case to request info.
ambiguities.encoded_as: Contraindications have no insufficient status; only 'found' routes.

ambiguities.issue: The engine cannot verify FDA authorization of the named device
readings: Assume authorized unless a statement says otherwise
Require a device name checked against a list
ambiguities.recommended: Assume authorized unless stated otherwise in v1; add a Northwind approved-device table later if wanted.

ambiguities.issue: Primary diagnosis G47.33 on the request but the notes describe central sleep apnea
ambiguities.recommended: Conflict, so clinician review. 3.3(d) will usually catch it anyway.
